# STS3215 servo model

`STS3215_03a.step` is the servo reference geometry from
[TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100), used by
`cad/robot.py` to form servo pockets. The STEP file is retained unchanged.

The upstream repository supplies the [Apache 2.0 license](LICENSE). This copy
was retrieved on 7 November 2026 from its
[LICENSE file](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100/blob/main/LICENSE)
(Git blob `261eeb9e9f8b2b4b0d119366dda99c6fd7d35c64`). It applies to the upstream
material; it does not license the rest of Tischlein.
